transcript: Speaker A: लड़का कैसा है? [How is the boy?] Speaker B: देखने में ठीक-ठाक है, नौकरी अच्छी है, घर भी है, पर एक प्रॉब्लम है। [He looks decent, has a good job, has a house, but there is one problem.] Speaker A: क्या? [What?] Speaker B: लड़के को इंग्लिश नहीं आती। [The boy doesn't know English.] Speaker A: फिर तो नहीं चलेगा। मेरी बेटी कॉन्वेंट से पढ़ी है, इंग्लिश में बात करती है और लड़के को इंग्लिश नहीं आती? शादी के बाद पार्टीज़ में क्या होगा? कैसे एडजस्ट करेगी मेरी बेटी? [Then it won't work. My daughter studied in a convent, speaks in English, and the boy doesn't know English? What will happen in parties after marriage? How will my daughter adjust?] Speaker C: मुझे पता चल गया, रिश्ता इसलिए नहीं आया क्योंकि मेरी इंग्लिश वीक है... [I found out, the proposal didn't come because my English is weak...] Speaker D: बेटा, इंग्लिश सीख ले, रिश्ते आएंगे। [Son, learn English, proposals will come.] Speaker C: रिश्ते के लिए इंग्लिश सीखूँ? [Should I learn English for a proposal?] Speaker D: रिश्ते के लिए नहीं, अपने लिए सीख। इंग्लिश आ गई तो रिश्ता भी आएगा और इज़्ज़त भी। [Not for a proposal, learn for yourself. If you know English, proposals will come and respect too.] Speaker C: इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड की... [Downloaded English Seekho app...] [Rohit practices English on the app, preparing introductions and good manners phrases] Speaker E: बेटा, टेल अस अबाउट योरसेल्फ। [Son, tell us about yourself.] Speaker C: Thank you aunty. My name is Rohit. I work as a senior accountant... I believe marriage is about families coming together and I would love to be part of yours. Speaker E: बेटा, चाय तो पी लो। [Son, at least have some tea.] Speaker C: पहली बार चाय का मतलब था रिश्ता आगे बढ़ेगा। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो... [For the first time, tea meant the proposal would go forward. Download English Seekho app...] Speaker F: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A young man faces rejection in marriage proposals due to his poor English skills. Encouraged by his mother, he uses the English Seekho app to practice daily and successfully passes his next family meeting. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
